firmware_change_required: Configure PA15 as GPIO input with no internal pulls; external R4 remains.

Retain PA13/PA14 SWD operation and verify connect-under-reset and held-button behavior.

findings: Table6 PA15 JTDI is not a SWD signal; SWD uses PA13/PA14.
Table7 permits PA15 release with JTAG disabled and SWD enabled.
JTDI has internal pull-up after reset; configure GPIO input explicitly.
